charts.title: Event-free vs full model — MAP / SVR / pathogen / tissue integrity overlay
charts.caption: Event-free (mean-hemodynamics) reduced model vs the exact pulsatile BioGears extraction, severe arm, 48 h. The reduced model drops the per-beat event and tracks blood pathogen and tissue integrity to within ~10% and the mean-MAP decline to ~4% RMSE. It under-reaches the deepest hemodynamic point (SVR ~0.78 vs 0.665; MAP ~80 vs 69.5 mmHg) — it captures the direction and most of the shock, trading hemodynamic depth and pulsatility (no SBP/DBP) for ~10^7x speed.
charts.key: Event-free vs full model — MAP / SVR / pathogen / tissue integrity overlay

charts.title: 48 h wall-clock — removing the beat event collapses the cost and the engine gap
charts.caption: 48 h wall-clock, log scale. The full pulsatile model (~205k beat events) takes ~2.81 h under roadrunner and ~3.7 h under COPASI. The event-free model runs in ~0.18 ms (roadrunner) and ~0.06 ms (COPASI) — ~6e+07x / ~2e+08x faster. With the events gone, COPASI is as fast as roadrunner (no per-event interpreter overhead), so the ~3x engine gap vanishes too.
charts.key: 48 h wall-clock — removing the beat event collapses the cost and the engine gap
